entities.name: Drufalden
entities.description: The last of the Rigida, an ice queen ruling a cold realm in the Borderlands.

entities.name: Rigida
entities.description: A line of ice rulers that once ruled most of Almaaz.

entities.name: Porros
entities.description: A powerful sand-wraith who enticed Drufalden.

entities.name: Ogwater Rifkin
entities.description: A songmage who came to reclaim his water sapphire from Drufalden.

entities.name: Water sapphire
entities.description: A magical gemstone Drufalden used to freeze land.

entities.name: Silver Sea
entities.description: A sea created when Drufalden froze land and lowered sea levels.

entities.name: Sarrazan River
entities.description: A river nearly stopped by Drufalden's freezing.

entities.name: River Kingdom
entities.description: A kingdom harmed by the freezing, where the sapphire ended up.

entities.name: Rotapan
entities.description: Ruler whose palace was destroyed in the flood; killed by Chelydrus.

entities.name: Chelydrus
entities.description: A creature in whose jaws Rotapan died.

entities.name: Flooding of Terisiare
entities.description: Event after which Drufalden lost power.

events.summary: Drufalden kills her two sisters and imprisons her mother until death, becoming the last of the Rigida.
events.quote: after having killed her own two sisters and imprisoned her mother until her death

events.summary: Drufalden uses a water sapphire to freeze a large section of land, creating the Silver Sea.
events.quote: she was able to draw enough strength to freeze a large section of land

events.summary: Drufalden loses her water sapphire while swimming in a stream; it ends up in the River Kingdom.
events.quote: she lost her water sapphire while swimming in a stream

events.summary: In 3050 AR Ogwater Rifkin receives the stone from the king of the selkies and casts a song spell melting the ice of Drufalden's realm.
events.quote: Ogwater used the gemstone to cast a great song spell to melt the ice of the Rigida's queendom.

events.summary: The flood destroys Rotapan's palace and Rotapan dies in the jaws of Chelydrus; Drufalden's grip on Almaaz is lost.
events.quote: her icy grip on Almaaz had been well and truly lost

relations.quote: came to reclaim his magical gemstone from Drufalden
ended his life in the jaws of Chelydrus
